newsitem.title: USA: Geotek unit says gets $31 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Geotek unit says gets $31 mln order.

text.p: Geotek Technologies said on Friday it received its first purchase order from Anam Telecom Co Ltd, worth $31 million.
Geotek, owned by Geotek Communications, said in a statement it would supply Anam Telecom with its FHMA infrastructure and related telecommunications equipment.
Geotek also said it expected to provide a range of business and engineering support for the design, implementation and operation of the FHMA digital netork.

FHMA, or Frequency Hopping Multiple Access, is a proprietary digital network which allows for fewer cellular base stations than traditional wireless networks, a company spokesman said. The network would be set up in Korea, he said.

"We believe that Anam Telecom will be a very significant customer and that this is the beginning of a long relationship," Geotek Technologies President and Chief Executive Officer Stephen Pearse said in a statement.
Anam is a consortium of 53 companies, including Anam Industrial, Hyundai Electronics and Korea Mobile Telecomm. Geotek said it held a 21 percent interest in Anam Telecom.
